reasoning_steps: Identify the initial and final temperatures of both refrigerators.
Note that the temperature of the refrigerator with its door open increased by 8.5°C.
Conclude that the refrigerator with its door open lost thermal energy to the surroundings.
Identify the temperature change in the refrigerator with its door closed.
Note that the temperature of the refrigerator with its door closed decreased by 2.3°C.
Conclude that the refrigerator with its door closed gained thermal energy from the surroundings.
Conclude that thermal energy transferred from the surroundings to each refrigerator.
